snippet.title: HEXCRAWL - Gameplay Trailer (v0.7)
snippet.description:
HEXCRAWL is a turn-based dark fantasy RPG about overland exploration, survival, and hard choices. You cross a procedurally generated world one hex at a time, as terrain, weather, and dwindling supplies push back.

Wishlist here on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4264250/HEXCRAWL/

---

Time passes. Hunger sets in. Random encounters—combat and non-combat—can reward you, wound you, or end the run. There is no safe route, only judgment calls and their consequences.

Choose your stakes: Mercy keeps your kit on death, Marked scatters your gear for others to reclaim, Mortal gives you one life.

The world spans deserts, jungles, swamps, tundra, volcanic wastes, and more—each zone with its own character. Ruins, forts, tombs, shipwrecks, and other sites dot the map; between them, Findings offer strange luck, hidden danger, or both.

Combat is tactical, fast, and lethal. You'll face hundreds of creatures and bosses—each with its own tricks and loot. When a fight turns ugly, fleeing is a gamble, and smoke bombs can buy you a clean escape.

There are no traditional levels. Power comes from what you carry and craft: weapons, armor, trinkets, consumables, and relics in a five-path crafting system—alchemy, smithing, leatherworking, cooking, and enchanting. Inventory is tight; every slot is a choice.

Settlements post bounties. Clear a zone and raise a Bastion that pays you while you wander. Read lore books and bestiaries in camp. Track recipes, quests, and achievements in an expanded Journal.

Progress is earned by exploring, surviving, and pushing into deadlier country. Push too far, and the world answers in kind.

---

Includes royalty-free music/ambience from Monument Studios (https://www.monumentstudios.net/). © Monument Studios.
